name: sh-actionable-recovered-syntax-edit-plans
instr:
mvdan.cc/sh/v3 cannot yet turn incomplete shell syntax into an actionable recovery plan. Add `RecoveryReport` to `mvdan.cc/sh/v3/syntax` so input-ordered, non-overlapping edits reconstruct missing syntax atomically. Reject duplicate, overlapping, already-applied, or stale edits without changing the source.

With `RecoverErrors(maximum int)`, record every grammar token, arithmetic delimiter, placeholder, or operand inserted by statement, word, and arithmetic parsing through `Parser.Recoveries`. Make `Pos.Recovery` and `Pos.IsRecovered()` associate and identify synthetic positions with records while keeping invalid positions distinct. Fatal unmatched closers remain errors without applicable reports.

Make `WalkRecoveries` visit records in tree preorder with subtree pruning, without changing `Walk` node, exit-callback, or position formatting. `MaterializeRecoveries`, `NewPrinter`, and `Printer.Print` must produce parseable shell text when requested and preserve default printing. Simplification must preserve applicability or explicitly report staleness.

Have `EncodeRecovery` and `DecodeRecovery` in `mvdan.cc/sh/v3/syntax/typedjson` atomically round-trip records and position associations. Keep metadata-free input valid, and reject malformed metadata without partial associations.

Make `SplitRecovering` and `SplitResult` in `mvdan.cc/sh/v3/shell` return partial arguments and the shared ordered report for incomplete Bash commands. Unsupported expansions remain errors. Reject recove
